verdict.rationale: Adyen documents webhooks so integrators can avoid polling for asynchronous status changes, and the risk docs say risk information, such as case-management routing and triggered risk rules, can be included in those webhooks. That covers the core of subscribing to risk-related events. Missing for 10: documentation of how to subscribe or configure endpoints and select event types, webhook security/verification details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
